name: Terreno Realty Corporation
summary: Terreno Realty Corporation an acquirer, owner and operator of industrial real estate in six major coastal U.S. markets. The firm announced today that it has executed new renewal leases totaling 233,000 square feet at Countyline Corporate Park Phase III in Hialeah, Florida. Countyline Corporate Park Buildings 26 and 28 total 422,000 square feet and are currently 100% leased to six tenants with 83,000 square feet expiring April 2027. To facilitate the new leases, Terreno Realty Corporation has executed an early termination effective July 31, 2026, with the tenant that was to expire April 2027.
